title: Claim
description: A unit of belief (housamkak v3 §6.3) — one line of llm-wiki/states/claims.jsonl, a materialized view rebuilt from the ledgers and never hand-edited. A claim is identified by claim_key plus conditions: several claims may share a key over time (supersession) or at once (scope split). probability and log_odds are the updater's log-odds-v2 arithmetic replayed over the transitions — recorded evidence weights and recorded decay factors, never recomputed; status follows the thresholds in the state rule. candidate is the note's 'uncertain'; stale and archived are written by decay_update rows and revived by support; rejected is human-only.

claim_id.description: clm_ + 12 hex of sha256(claim_key · creating observation_id).

status.description: stale: an active claim decayed below P_ACTIVE unconfirmed; archived: belief decayed below P_ARCHIVE — still matchable, so new support revives rather than forks it, but it counts for no page.

exceptions.description: §8.6 — a general rule plus its exceptions, each tied to the observation that created it.

entity_ids.description: Entities the claim names — the join to the pages that render it.

siblings.description: Claims sharing this key under disjoint conditions (§8.5 scope split).

last_decayed_at.description: Timestamp of the newest decay_update row folded into this claim; null until the first. Decay elapses from max(last_confirmed_at, last_decayed_at).

decay_profile.description: §8.8 vocabulary, derived at fold: the newest supporting observation's explicit decay_profile, else the channel default of the creating observation's source; selects the half-life decay applies.

source_authority_weight.description: The highest source_authority among the supporting sources — how authoritative the best evidence is.

needs_review.description: True when disputed, or active with contradicting evidence a human has not yet judged. A human_override transition marks the claim reviewed, which clears the flag until a new contradiction arrives.
